desc:
Experience detailed customization and modifications
From fairing customizations to wheel sizes, and even engine specifications with real-time updated dyno graph!
From appearance characteristics to technical specifications, all yours to customize!

Earn money by riding around the map and participate drag races at the drag strips!
Note: Passenger earns money too 👀

Controls (while seated on a bike)
F - Toggle engine state
Q/E - Downshift/Upshift
Left Shift - Decouple Clutch
Note: Release clutch while in gear and on throttle will perform a clutch dump 👀
W - Throttle
S - Brake (will reverse the bike if in neutral gear)
A - Steer Left
D - Steer Right
X - Hazard Lights
Left Ctrl - Wheelie



Tags: bike, modification
